description: Seven builder stories: OpenAI's Astra for Law with a 230M-URL legal index, TypeSafe's Jev decision model, Cua's 706K-parameter forms planner, California's kill-switch order, Qwen's omni-modal agent, a stealth-model reveal, and a 27B model in 5.9GB.
lead: Vertical agents, decision-shaped models, and tiny weights lead the last 24 hours. OpenAI aimed its flagship at legal work on top of a massive case-law index, two new releases replace text generation with scored decisions for automation, and a ternary-quantized 27B model squeezes onto a laptop. California ordered frontier-lab audits plus kill-switch plans, Qwen shipped an omni-modal agent that acts on audio and video, and a mystery model topped the charts before naming itself. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 19, 2026: legal agents, tiny models, and kill switches
